name: sim: kernel and an error collector
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.__errs = []; window.addEventListener('error', (e) => window.__errs.push(e.message)); window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => window.__errs.push(String(e.reason?.message ?? e.reason))); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); return 'ready'; })()

fem: static study on quadratic tets in the worker, with refinement faces, probes and the mesh controls
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.pmSet('study', 'static'); const e = m.state.editing; Object.assign(e, window.__fx); e.magnitude = 1000; e.dir = '-z'; e.loadKind = 'force'; e.elementSize = 6; e.refine = [window.__fx.fixtures[0]]; e.refineSize = 3; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); await sleep(300); const r = e.result; const html = document.querySelector('.left-pm-body')?.innerHTML ?? document.body.innerHTML; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, solver: r?.solver, model: Boolean(r?.model?.nodes?.length), colours: Boolean(m.state.sim?.colors?.length), mesh: html.includes('data-pm-field="elementSize"'), probes: html.includes('data-pm-pick="probes"') }); })()

eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.pmSet('study', 'modal'); const e = m.state.editing; Object.assign(e, window.__fx); e.elementSize = 6; e.modes = 3; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); const r = e.result; return JSON.stringify({ n: r?.frequencies?.length, pos: Boolean(r?.frequencies?.every((x) => x > 0)) }); })()

name: fem: assembly study with bonded contact between components shows coloured result bodies
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('asmPillowLine'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); await m.run('assemblySimulation'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const e = m.state.editing; const B = e._bodies; const big = (b) => { const V = b.mesh.vertices, T = b.mesh.triangles; const list = b.mesh.faceGroups.filter((g) => b.faces.find((x) => x.hashCode === g.faceId)?.geomType === 'PLANE').map((g) => { let a = 0; for (let t = g.start; t < g.start + g.count; t += 3) { const p = [3 * T[t], 3 * T[t + 1], 3 * T[t + 2]]; const u = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => V[p[1] + k] - V[p[0] + k]), v = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => V[p[2] + k] - V[p[0] + k]); a += 0.5 * Math.hypot(u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]); } return { g, a }; }).sort((p, q) => q.a - p.a); const g = list[0].g; return { index: b.faces.findIndex((x) => x.hashCode === g.faceId), faceId: g.faceId }; }; e.fixtures = [{ ...big(B[0]), body: 0, bodyKey: B[0].key, bodyName: B[0].name, kind: 'fixed' }]; e.loads = [{ ...big(B[1]), body: 1, bodyKey: B[1].key, bodyName: B[1].name }]; e.magnitude = 500; e.elementSize = 20; e.contact = 'bonded'; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const r = e.result; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, n: r?.bodies?.length === B.length, contact: r?.contact?.constraints > 0, shown: Boolean(m.viewport.bodies.get('femres:0')), pm: Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="contact"]')) }); })()
